description: This file defines a class named HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeEmbed that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform. The class is responsible for transforming attributes related to safe embedding of flash content, specifically setting script access, networking, and type attributes for an embed element.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_SafeEmbed
classes.description: A class that transforms attributes for safe embedding, setting security-related attributes for embedded flash content.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the given attributes by setting specific security-related attributes for embedding content.
